review_order: Viewed all numbered image panels before opening the stratum/source ledger. The selection was frozen before this inspection. Aggregate performance was already known to the reviewer, so the inspection is partially blinded, not a pre-score identity validation.

blinded_observations.01: The walker changes apparent scale as the camera distance decreases. Raw points are absent in the far initial still and broadly follow the visible body in the other two; some distal points extend beyond the frame.
blinded_observations.02: One apparent walker is visible in the three stills, with raw pose unavailable in the midpoint. Still availability alone cannot determine whole-window quality.
blinded_observations.03: Crowded scene. Raw points select different foreground people across the stills, so continuity with an intended annotated walker is uncertain.
blinded_observations.04: Two adjacent people. Raw points consistently follow the person at image right rather than the person at image left using an aid. The intended annotated identity must be checked separately.
blinded_observations.05: One apparent distant walker. Pose is absent in midpoint/end stills, and the final still is darkened.
blinded_observations.06: One apparent walker approaches the camera. Initial raw points are absent; later points broadly follow the body, with final head and distal boundary truncation.
blinded_observations.07: A walker using an aid remains visible in three corridor stills. Points broadly follow the body, but a narrow view and limb overlap prevent anatomical validation.
blinded_observations.08: One apparent background walker is tracked at early/midpoint stills. A cyclist occludes the lower body near the final still; individual joint accuracy remains uncertain.
blinded_observations.09: Split-screen recording contains two walking views and text overlays. Raw pose is absent in initial/midpoint stills and selects one figure near the end; no single continuous observation stream is visually established.
blinded_observations.10: One apparent walker is visible through the selected stills. Some foot and distal points deviate from visible outlines; precise joints and clinical state are unverified.

unblinded_disposition: Panels03,04,09 are rejected sequences. Their metadata show outside-person-box or missing-pelvis gates, consistent with the obvious identity/split-screen hazards. Panels01,06 are accepted sequences but selected boundary stills are missing; acceptance applies to sufficient contiguous windows, not every frame. Accepted panel08 retains a visible occlusion risk. No new exclusions or efficacy-dependent rule changes are made.
claim_boundary: This audit demonstrates review coverage and concrete observation hazards. It does not establish whole-cohort tracking accuracy, diagnosis, or identity validity. The source selection covers only ten of 96 extraction-candidate sources.
